summary: Settings in the Juggluco app for use with AAPS: turning off Juggluco's Nightscout upload, then sending glucose either directly to AAPS (xDrip broadcast) or through xDrip (Patched Libre). Either way the reader selects the xDrip+ BG source and applies smoothing in AAPS.

sections.heading: Juggluco settings
sections.summary: Downloading Juggluco and connecting the sensor following its own instructions.

sections.heading: Basic settings for all CGM systems
sections.summary: Heading for settings that apply to every sensor.

sections.heading: Disable Nightscout uploader
sections.summary: Turning off any Nightscout upload in Juggluco, since AAPS 3.2+ uploads the data itself.

sections.heading: Juggluco to AAPS
sections.summary: Sending glucose straight from Juggluco to AAPS with the xDrip broadcast, selecting the xDrip+ BG source in AAPS and applying smoothing there. Libre minute readings do not trigger minute calculations.

sections.heading: Juggluco to xDrip
sections.summary: Sending glucose from Juggluco to xDrip with Patched Libre; xDrip averages and smooths Libre readings before passing them to AAPS, where the xDrip+ BG source is selected.
